views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.name_id AS director_id,
  n.name AS director_name,
  m.id AS movie_id,
  m.date_published,
  m.duration,
  r.avg_rating,
  r.total_votes
FROM director_mapping d
LEFT JOIN names n ON d.name_id = n.id
LEFT JOIN movies m ON d.movie_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
views.description: Task: Compute the top 9 directors ranked by how many movies they directed, and for each director produce their id, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to nearest integer), av
